locked_validation_window.rule: last 40 percent of the raw time_msc span after the zip checksum matches
locked_validation_window.note: Discovery code must not aggregate this window. Inventory of the whole archive is allowed and is not a strategy fit.

hypotheses.mechanism: quote bounce: a mid-price change larger than the prevailing spread is followed by a reversal more often than a continuation, after paying one spread
hypotheses.prediction: on the discovery window, reversal frequency exceeds 0.5 after one spread cost
hypotheses.null: the sign of the next mid change is independent of the previous sign once one spread is paid
competitors: spread bounce that is only the bid-ask bounce and has no residual
stale repeated quotes counted as reversals
hypotheses.falsification: discovery-window residual after one spread is not distinguishable from zero, or it depends on dropping inverted quotes or gaps
hypotheses.data: canonical zip after checksum match; bid and ask required
hypotheses.population: XAUUSD quotes in the discovery window only
hypotheses.regime: not conditioned; a regime split would be a new hypothesis
hypotheses.execution_and_cost_assumptions: one full spread paid on the reversal; no latency, no partial fill, no queue
hypotheses.validation_method: not run; validation window remains locked

hypotheses.mechanism: wide spreads coincide with larger subsequent absolute mid changes beyond the spread itself
hypotheses.prediction: mean absolute next mid change divided by spread is higher after spreads above the discovery-window median than after spreads below it
hypotheses.null: no difference in spread-scaled absolute next change between the two pre-declared spread halves
competitors: wide spreads are just the cost, with no extra movement
the split threshold was chosen after seeing the result
hypotheses.falsification: the two halves do not differ, or the comparison requires a searched threshold
hypotheses.population: valid positive bid and ask quotes in the discovery window
hypotheses.regime: binary split at the discovery-window median spread, declared here, not searched
hypotheses.execution_and_cost_assumptions: this is a mechanism check, not a strategy; no order is implied

hypotheses.mechanism: two pre-declared clock windows, London 07:00-08:00 UTC and New York 13:00-14:00 UTC, have a mean mid change different from the complement after one spread
hypotheses.prediction: at least one window differs from its complement after Holm adjustment across the two windows
hypotheses.null: both windows have zero excess mean change versus the complement after one spread
competitors: apparent seasonality is an unverified timestamp offset
hypotheses.falsification: blocked, not tested, unless timestamp_interpretation_confirmed is true; a provisional UTC rendering is not confirmation
hypotheses.data: canonical zip after checksum match and a confirmed timestamp basis
features: hour of week under confirmed UTC
hypotheses.regime: the two hours are the only clock conditions; no other hour may be reported as a test
hypotheses.validation_method: not run; blocked until timestamp basis is confirmed

constraints: Do not repair gaps, inverted quotes, or timestamp order to obtain a result.
Do not run H-TOD-01 on an unconfirmed clock.
A passing discovery statistic is not VALIDATED and does not authorize DEMO_EXECUTION.
Failed and blocked hypotheses stay recorded.
